text:
maria: Hey team — I pushed updates to PR #612 (branch: feat/serve-shim). I addressed the review comments on test layout, moved the flaky integ into a small shim, and added a changelog note. Re-requesting a review when you have a minute.

samir: Thanks — I'll carve out 30m and go through it.

alex: Quick skim — looks good overall. Left a tiny nit about the fixture name in tests.

jen: Heads-up: can we hold merge until we have a canary slot? last rollout had some capacity noise. I can reserve tomorrow morning if that helps.

maria: Yes, holding is fine unless we get +2 and a free canary. Note: I converted one slow e2e into a focused unit that exercises the cache eviction logic so it should be deterministic now.

ci-bot: build: 612/feat/serve-shim — CI passed (unit, lint, integration-lite). flaky-integ-suite: rerun 1/2.

samir: Reproduced the fixture nit, pushing a tiny rename in a followup commit. Also added a short comment in test_utils explaining why we stub the scheduler.

alex: If you want a clean history, I can squash before merge. Otherwise current single-commit squash looks fine.

maria: I rebased onto main and squashed into one commit with an expanded message (includes why the shim helps with flaky infra). Diff snippet:```diff
- tests/integ/test_cache.py::test_eviction
+ tests/unit/test_cache_shim.py::test_eviction_shim
```

maria: Also updated CHANGELOG.md with: "avoid flaky integ by isolating eviction behavior in unit shim; improves reliability of canary runs."

jen: Morning 09:30 PT works for canary — reserving slot now in the rollout calendar.

samir: Reviewed after the rename — approved. tiny nit about wording resolved in latest push.

alex: Approved as well. :shipit:

maria: Thanks all — I'll merge at 09:30 PT unless anyone objects. If CI flips flaky again I'll pause and ping here.

jen: No objections. Thanks for the cleanup, this should make canaries quieter.

ci-bot: deploy-scheduler: scheduled merge for 1765481400 (2026-03-19 09:30:00 PT).
